anchor_value: USD-denominated schedule columns shown with dollar markers

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Industry | Issuer | Acquisition Date | Investment | % of Net Assets | Par Amount | Maturity Date | Amortized Cost | Fair Value

rationale: FX03 flagged cost_currency as non-USD because the stored unit value is U_USD. The raw schedule-of-investments source shows the affected amortized-cost and fair-value columns are dollar-denominated, with dollar markers on the relevant schedule pages and total row. U_USD is therefore a USD unit label rather than evidence of foreign currency; the flagged value is source-consistent and the rule/string normalization is overbroad.
